name: kb-local

scripts.conformance: export CAK_DATA_DIR="${CAK_DATA_DIR:-$(mktemp -d)}"; npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract kb.list --args '{}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract kb.query --args '{"q":"hello","limit":3}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract kb.ingest --args '{"paths":["README.md"]}'

description: CAK 插件：本地知识库（kb.ingest@1 / kb.query@1 / kb.list@1）— SQLite FTS5 + BM25 全文检索，零外部依赖
